svg.title: Clean simulation versus a sensor's view of the same flow
svg.desc: Original illustration generated by make_flow_animation.py: vorticity in the wake of a NACA4418 airfoil from a small lattice-Boltzmann simulation, on an 86 by 54 grid. Left, the clean simulated field. Right, the same simulated flow at a different moment, blurred and noisy like PIV data. Not competition data and not a model prediction. Motion stops when reduced motion is preferred.
